source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies homogeneous quasi-translations and their linear invariants in dimension five; it does not present the proposed symmetric-gradient positive-cone kernel-rigidity theorem.

The paper gives a graphical sufficient condition for generic identifiability of linear structural-equation-model parameters from covariance matrices, not a self-normalizing-denominator classification.
